description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the views_ui module, including help text, entity type building, plugin alterations, view analysis, and entity operations.

classes.name: ViewsUiHooks
classes.description: Contains hook implementations for the views_ui module, including help, entity type build, plugin alterations, view analysis, and entity operations.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information for the views_ui module, including links to documentation, managing views, enabling/disabling views, and import/export options.

methods.name: entityTypeBuild
methods.description: Defines form classes and link templates for the 'view' entity type.

methods.name: viewsPluginsDisplayAlter
methods.description: Attaches contextual links to each display plugin for editing and actions.

methods.name: contextualLinksViewAlter
methods.description: Modifies or removes contextual links in view previews based on suppression settings.

methods.name: viewsAnalyze
methods.description: Performs basic analysis on a view, warning if only default display exists or if display paths conflict with aliases.

methods.name: entityOperation
methods.description: Provides entity operations, such as editing a view, for block entities associated with views.
